engine_help:
usage: codeaudit [-h] [--workspaces WORKSPACES] [--local-tools]
                 [--keep-source] [--no-knowledge] [--quiet]
                 [--policy-file POLICY_FILE] [--focus FOCUS]
                 [--max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS] [--max-calls MAX_CALLS]
                 [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                 source

AI-driven code audit V2

positional arguments:
  source                Git URL, ZIP, or local source directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspaces WORKSPACES
  --local-tools         Development adapter; not OctoBus acceptance
  --keep-source         Retain snapshot for audit replay (otherwise cleaned
                        after run)
  --no-knowledge        Knowledge ablation only
  --quiet               Suppress progress events on stderr
  --policy-file POLICY_FILE
                        UTF-8 business policy supplied by the operator (at
                        most 8000 characters); not source evidence
  --focus FOCUS         Optional operator-defined audit scope; not evidence or
                        an expected verdict
  --max-iterations MAX_ITERATIONS
  --max-calls MAX_CALLS
  --timeout TIMEOUT     Audit budget in seconds; a pending model request may
                        add up to its request timeout
scheduler_trigger_help:
Manually run a scheduler trigger

Usage:
  agent-compose scheduler trigger <agent> <trigger> [flags]

Flags:
  -d, --detach           Start the scheduler run and return immediately
      --driver string    Unsupported for complete scheduler runs
  -h, --help             help for trigger
      --jupyter          Unsupported for complete scheduler runs
      --jupyter-expose   Unsupported for complete scheduler runs
      --keep-running     Unsupported for complete scheduler runs
      --payload string   JSON payload passed to main or the trigger callback
      --prompt string    Unsupported for complete scheduler runs; scheduler scripts own their agent prompts
      --rm               Unsupported for complete scheduler runs
      --sandbox string   Unsupported for complete scheduler runs

Global Flags:
  -f, --file string           Path to agent-compose.yml
      --host string           Daemon HTTP endpoint
      --json                  Print machine-readable JSON
      --project-name string   Override compose project name
